effect.name: Film Halation
effect.desc: Extracts highlights above a soft-knee threshold, tints them with a custom color or film-stock preset, blurs them at an inner and an outer radius in half-resolution buffers, and recombines them with per-channel red/green/blue bleed. Adds optional edge halation, gate weave and flicker, saturation/warmth/fade grading, dither, and Add/Screen/Soft Light compositing.
